details:
This update for amazon-cloudwatch-agent fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-84303: google.golang.org/grpc: xDS RBAC HTTP filter implementation issue allows for bypass of authorization
  policies via mixed-case or canonical-case header matches (bsc#1279334).
- CVE-2026-84304: google.golang.org/grpc: heap memory exhaustion via HTTP/2 DATA frame fragmentation (bsc#1279235).
- CVE-2026-84445: google.golang.org/grpc: DoS via crash due to missing `:authority` and `Host` headers in gRPC-Go xDS
  servers (bsc#1279393).

Changes for amazon-cloudwatch-agent:

- Update to version 1.300072.0
 
 * [DatabaseInsights] Enable PostgreSQL execution plan collection
 by @AshuSrv in (#2225)
 * [DatabaseInsights] Add workload detection for PostgreSQL database
 servers by @Paamicky in (#2220)
 * [ApplicationSignals] Preserve jvm.gc.name attribute in GC runtime
 metrics to differentiate collector types by @ezhang6811 in (#2218)
 * [DatabaseInsights] Split PostgreSQL per-resource metrics to a dedicated
 60s receiver to reduce collection overhead by @EduVencovsky in (#2232)
 * [Agent] Bump grpc and golang.org/x/net dependencies
 by @dependabot in (#2217) and @movence in (#2242)
 * [Agent] Fix AKS cloud.resource_id derivation to use the cluster
 resource group by @jefchien in (#2237)
  
- Lock github.com/prometheus/common at v0.62.0
  
- Update to version 1.300071.0
 
 * [OpenTelemetry] Add file tailing and Windows Events support
 by @jefchien in (#2206) and (#2193)
 * [OpenTelemetry] Add resource_attributes support by @movence in (#2207)
 * [Agent] Add set-env ctl action to persist agent environment variables
 by @sky333999 in (#2211)
 * [Agent] Add platform-aware default configs for OpenTelemetry (host,
 Kubernetes, ECS) by @jefchien in (#2179)
 * [Agent] Add Microsoft Azure support for VMs and AKS by @movence in (#2183)
 * [OpenTelemetry] Add root-level cluster_name and standardize collection_interval
 by @Paamicky in (#2189)
 * [Agent] Retain custom environment variables in env-config.json between
 translation by @jefchien in (#2131)
 * [DatabaseInsights] Add severity parsing and fix multiline/timestamp for
 PostgreSQL server logs by @JayPolanco in (#2209)
 * [Logs] Fix throttling deadlock in cloudwatchlogs output plugin when destinations
 are removed by @lorespiz in (#2190)
 * [Logs] Fix force-flush timer permanently stalling on low-volume log streams
 by @musa-asad in (#2166)
 * [Logs] Add journald log collection support by @Paamicky in (#2121)
 * [OpenTelemetry] Add new opentelemetry section in JSON configuration to support
 sending telemetry to CloudWatch OTLP endpoints by @mitali-salvi in (#2152)
 * [DatabaseInsights] Add support for self-managed PostgreSQL metrics and logs
 collection by @JayPolanco in (#2172)
 * [ApplicationSignals] Fix Service Events logs and metrics pipelines
 to use shared AWS credential chain by @jefchien in (#2151)
